To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the interconnection of classes is an important feature in the design and programming phases of OO development; and (2) the interconnection paradigm presented in this paper can be used to increase class decouple and thus reuse.
the interconnection features in the object-oriented development tools facilitate reuse.

(1) the use of interconnection languages in the design and implementation of OO applications increases the decoupling of the classes, and therefore facilitates their reuse; (2) the use of asynchronous messages sent to generic receivers in a second generation OO development environment facilitates the reuse of the classes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an OO system in which interconnection features are available for the design of the application, and are used at the programming level to implement the interconnections.
the design and implementation of a system for the specification and implementation of OO applications.
the design and implementation of a language for interconnections in object-oriented development environments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the interconnection features are a powerful tool that allows us to achieve a high level of class reuse.
the use of interconnection languages in the design and programming of OO applications is a promising approach to increase class decouple, and hence reuse.
interconnection languages can be successfully applied at the design level, and that their use at the programming level is not so easy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the interconnection paradigm can be used to decouple classes in OO systems.
we are able to reuse a class in an application without having to change it or its interconnection features, and without violating the principle of information-hiding.
we are trying to develop a new, more general, more reusable, more modular, more decoupled and more object-oriented programming paradigm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the interconnection features of the language can be used to increase the reuse of classes and class libraries.
the use of interconnection features at different levels in a system can increase the decoupling of classes and thus the reuse of OO applications.
interconnections can be used as a powerful tool for OO design and programming.
